task: GSM8K 8-shot CoT, 250 dev questions, greedy, Gemma 3n E4B bf16
quality_gate: <= 5 pp accuracy loss vs static_L; certified only if the 95% paired bootstrap lower bound is >= -5 pp

restrictions.switch_directions: both allowed: no difference between large->small and small->large
restrictions.min_dwell_steps: 4 (smallest tested; alt4 is no worse than a single switch)
restrictions.max_switches_per_request: no limit supported by the data up to ~25 switches per answer (alt4)
restrictions.per_step_quality_penalty: none: every switching schedule lands between static_L and static_S, so there is no measured transition cost to model

caveats: n = 250 gives paired 95% CIs of about +-5 pp; differences under ~5 pp cannot be resolved
one task (GSM8K) and one model; SQuAD pilot showed a larger Large-Small gap (6.5 pp)
schedules are global per step, matching one configuration per serving iteration
